Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service operation with affiliates hacking businesses and encrypting devices
Uses enterprise Windows Active Directory APIs to worm through networks
Uses Windows Active Directory Service Interfaces API to perform LDAP queries and spread ransomware to other devices on the network
Copies ransomware executable to remote devices and creates Windows services to load and encrypt devices
Leverages stolen domain credentials to encrypt all devices in compromised Windows domain
Attack Vector: Use of Windows Active Directory APIs for network worming and spreading
Command-line argument /NETWORK to enable worm feature requiring Windows domain
